name: Pending Cancellation Reason 10 Choice
definition: Choice between a standard code or a proprietary code to specify the reason why a cancellation request sent for the related instruction is pending.

Code.name: Code
Code.definition: Standard code to specify the reason why a cancellation request sent for the related instruction is pending.

Proprietary.name: Proprietary
Proprietary.definition: Proprietary identification of the reason why a cancellation request sent for the related instruction is pending.
